ops.text: (c) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Contractor shall (i) at Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Contractor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, return to Company all Company data in Contractor's possession or control in a standard machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete all such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Company in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit provision as a new Section 6(c): up to six (6) months of transition assistance at Contractor's then-current rates, return of our data in a standard machine-readable format within thirty (30) days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion thereafter. The Agreement has no data-return or wind-down mechanic today; 90 days of assistance with export within 30 days is our fallback.
proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance, return of Company data in a standard machine-readable format, and certified deletion in Section 6 (Termination).
